description: Texts spoken in DECtalk's spelling mode, the mode command standing before any spoken text: words of letters, capitals, digits, marks inside a word, each clause mark after a word, several sentences, a sentence that begins with an auxiliary, words the text rules read in their own way outside the mode (a number, money, a time, an abbreviation, an initialism, quotation marks, parentheses), phonemic text, a text with no closing mark, and the mode set, cleared and set again before the text. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.
